name: Envy (Linux dev checks)
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-format-18 clang-tidy cppcheck && bash -lc 'source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm install 24 && nvm alias default 24' && NODE24="$(ls -d "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/v24.*/bin 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n1)" && [ -n "$NODE24" ] && export PATH="$NODE24:$PATH" && [ "$(node -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]')" = 24 ] && npm --prefix Remote/tests ci --no-audit --no-fund
